meaning: A phone call that plays a recorded message instead of a live person. Many are unwanted, and some are scams.
clues: You answer the phone and a recording starts talking.
A computer dials thousands of numbers, and you are just one of them.
Many are selling something or trying to scam you.
A recorded sales pitch is against the rules unless you said yes in writing first.
It has eight letters and starts with R. Think of a robot making a call.
assumes: Spoofing makes a call look like it came from another number
Catfishing is pretending to be someone else online

decoys.meaning: Making a call or text look like it came from a different number or name than the real one.
Pretending to be someone else online, with a fake name and fake photos, to fool a person.
Someone uses your name or account numbers without your permission, such as to buy things in your name.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Back in my day, when the phone rang, a real person was on the line. Usually Aunt Marge.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: If it is a recording you did not ask for, hang up. Do not press any buttons, not even one that says "opt out".

sources.name: FCC, Stop Unwanted Robocalls and Texts
